radiusSource: Radius 60.357 (56.193 to 68.291) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 41,990,332 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 5.209 (5.169 to 5.406) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5556100402847981056: teff_gspphot 4328.477 K (16th-84th percentiles 4284.384-4355.2593), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5556100402847981056: teff_gspphot 4328.477 K (16th-84th percentiles 4284.384-4355.2593), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
